item_name: Electronic Resistors (Carbon Film, Metal Film, and Wirewound)
hazards: Older or industrial resistors may contain lead-based solder coatings or ceramic dust if crushed. Sharp wire leads can prick skin.
safe_handling: Keep loose resistors inside a small container or zip-lock bag so wire leads do not scatter.
unsafe_actions: Do not burn components or dispose of bulk electronic parts in regular household waste.
what_to_do_if_damaged: Sweep up cracked ceramic pieces with a brush and seal them in a small bag before placing them in e-waste collection.
disposal_route: Submit with mixed electronic components at an authorized e-waste collection center.
recoverable_materials: Copper leads, steel caps, and trace nickel or chromium alloys.
environmental_impact: Landfilling large quantities of electronic components introduces lead solder and non-biodegradable ceramics into soil.
